description: This source file defines the Basket class, an entity representing a shopping basket in an e-commerce application. It manages basket items, allows adding and removing items, and tracks total items. It also includes methods for modifying the Basket's buyer ID.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket entity with methods for managing basket items and buyer information.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new Basket with a buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or increases quantity if item already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items with zero quantity from the basket.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
